name: Traveler (Geo)
notes: KQM has no Geo Traveler guide; the card rests on Game8 (Geo Burst Sub-DPS) and genshin-builds.com (Geo DPS build, checked 2026-10-30). They agree on 4pc Nighttime Whispers in the Echoing Woods first, an ATK% Sands (Game8 allows ER), a Geo DMG Goblet and a CRIT Circlet, with Primordial Jade Cutter and Mistsplitter Reforged among the top weapons. They differ on the second set (Game8: Emblem of Severed Fate; genshin-builds: Golden Troupe) and on talent order: Game8 is Burst > Skill > Normal Attack, genshin-builds Skill > Burst > Normal Attack (a quick-swap DPS). The card uses Game8's order: the Burst's shockwaves (148% to 266% each, elemental curve) are the damage. No source gives numeric goals. genshin-builds' Geo page reads partly as generic text, so its weight is small. Partners are inferred (Geo for resonance, Pyro and Hydro for Crystallize).
